summaries.title: One Polluted Page Is Enough: Evaluating Web Content Pollution in LLM Recommenders
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**安全对齐与可解释性**（Safety & Interp）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **One Polluted Page Is Enough** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：We introduce FORGE (Fake Online Recommendations in Generative Environments), which locally rewrites real products in a frozen set of retrieved web pages into fake ones and...。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：We introduce FORGE (Fake Online Recommendations in Generative Environments), which locally rewrites real products in a frozen set of retrieved web pages into fake...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **27%, 73.8%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Across 12 commercial and open-weights LLMs, all models are vulnerable: a single polluted page yields fooled rates of up to 27%, while the full top-3 replacement raises this to 73.8%）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞），本工作修正了对 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: RIBOSPAN: A Long-Context RNA Foundation Model for Versatile RNA Modeling
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**AI4Science与记忆评测**（Science & Eval）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **RIBOSPAN** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖AI4Science与记忆评测（Science & Eval）。核心论点主张：We present RIBOSPAN, a 1.61-billion-parameter bidirectional RNA foundation model natively pretrained with context lengths up to 10,240 nt。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用迭代去噪生成/流匹配建模。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **10,240 tokens, 10K models**。实验设计与验证细节：We evaluate the model through nucleotide reconstruction, a controlled long-context representation benchmark, and frozen RNA-type representation analysis。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **40%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Native 10K pretraining preserves strong reconstruction at 10,240 tokens, while continued pretraining with 40%...；Frozen-representation evaluations further demonstrate state-of-the-art RNA representation quality, with RIBOSPAN...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为细分方向的扎实推进（HF 2 赞，出自 SII-GAIR），本工作为突破 **科学智能 (生物/化学/物理/医疗)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。
